description: This is a Java test class for OFBiz's integration with ClearCommerce payment services. It contains unit tests for authorization, credit, subscription management, and reporting functionalities related to ClearCommerce payment gateway.

classes.name: CCServicesTest
classes.description: JUnit-based test class for verifying ClearCommerce payment service integrations in OFBiz.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process with ClearCommerce, verifying success response and auth result.

methods.name: testCredit
methods.description: Tests the credit (refund/deduction) process with ClearCommerce, verifying success response and credit result.

methods.name: testPurchaseSubscription
methods.description: Tests purchasing a subscription via ClearCommerce, validating the service response.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing free subscription scenario, currently not implemented.

methods.name: testCancelSubscription
methods.description: Placeholder for testing canceling a subscription, notes that actual cancellation via API may not be supported.

methods.name: testCCReport
methods.description: Tests querying the transaction report/status from ClearCommerce, checking for a successful response.
